Exam 1 Review
Phasors, three-phase circuits, transformer tests, and

Buxin She
Mike Wiegers Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

Review outline
1 Part 1: RMS phasors and complex power.
2 Part 2: balanced three-phase circuits and feeder calculations.
3 Part 3: transformer tests and per-unit calculations.
4 Part 4: solution checks. Optional review: planning arithmetic.
The core follows the electrical topics through L14 reviewed in L16. Planning pages are
optional extension.

PART 4
Solution checks

Review error checks
1 Phasors: use RMS magnitude, the declared cosine reference, and the current
conjugate.
2 Connections: carry the positive-sequence angle and line/phase factors.
3 Transformer tests: keep the measured side and the referred side explicit.
4 Per unit: put old and new voltage bases on the same physical side.
5 Conservation: close total load, modeled loss, and delivered source power.
A final value needs a visible calculation chain and an independent check.
